```{r}
setwd(dirname(rstudioapi::documentPath()))
library(Rcpp)
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
# Checking
library(ggrepel)
# hu <- load("Elli_20251006/mcmc_model_3.rda")#mcmc_model

hu <- load("pep_joined_with_isofrac_3.RData")
# updated pep_joined
hu <- load("RPE1_DIA_markers_3.rda")#marker vector "combined"
hu <- load("tagm_pep.RData")#another pep_joined
# Generating PCA
pep_pca <- pep_joined %>%
  filterNA() %>%
  plot2D(method = "PCA", plot = F)

FD <- pep_joined@featureData@data
pep_pca <- as.data.table(pep_pca)
pep_pca <- cbind(pep_pca,FD)

markers <- pep_pca[markers!="unknown"]
markersCollapsed <- markers[,1,.(Protein.Group,markers,IsoFracID)]
markersCollapsed$V1 <- NULL
markersCollapsed$IsoFracID <- gsub(" .*.","",markersCollapsed$IsoFracID)
markersCollapsed$Protein.Group <- gsub("_.*.","",markersCollapsed$Protein.Group)
setnames(markersCollapsed,"IsoFracID","EnsemblGeneID")
fwrite(markersCollapsed,"Markers_Table.txt",sep="\t")


```

## PCA Projection


```{r}
ggplot(pep_pca,aes(`PC1 (25.2%)`,`PC2 (18.88%)`,color=markers))+geom_point()+facet_wrap("markers")+ggtitle("All")
ggplot(pep_pca[!is.na(IsoFrac_MW)],aes(`PC1 (25.2%)`,`PC2 (18.88%)`,color=markers))+geom_point()+facet_wrap("markers")+ggtitle("IsoFracMapped")

ggplot(pep_pca[grep("P07339",Protein.Group)],aes(`PC1 (25.2%)`,`PC2 (18.88%)`,label=Stripped.Sequence,color=markers))+geom_point()+ggtitle("All")+geom_text_repel(size=2.5)

ggplot(pep_pca[grep("P46108",Protein.Group)],aes(`PC1 (25.2%)`,`PC2 (18.88%)`,label=Stripped.Sequence,color=markers))+geom_point()+ggtitle("All")+geom_text_repel(size=2.5)

ggplot(pep_pca[grep("P19838",Protein.Group)],aes(`PC1 (25.2%)`,`PC2 (18.88%)`,label=Stripped.Sequence,color=as.character(IsoFrac_MW)))+geom_point()+ggtitle("All")+geom_text_repel(size=2.5)






```

## PCA
- extract data from MSnSet Object
- run PCA seperately to get access to all PCs
```{r}
pep_filtered <- pep_joined %>% filterNA()
dt <- exprs(pep_filtered)

fd <- pep_joined@featureData@data
NAMES <- combined[((match(gsub("_.*.","",fd$Protein.Group),names(combined))))]
NAMES[is.na(NAMES)] <- "UNKNOWN"

str(pep_joined)
dtPCA  <- prcomp(pep_joined@assayData$exprs,scale. = T)
pc <- data.table(dtPCA$x)
pc$Marker <- NAMES
pc$Sequence <- rownames(pep_joined@assayData$exprs)



ggplot(pc,aes(PC1,PC2,color=Marker))+geom_point()+facet_wrap("Marker")



#[!is.na(match(markers,c("ER","Lysosome")))]
ggplot(pep_pca[markers!="unknown"],aes(`PC1 (25.2%)`,`PC2 (18.88%)`,color=markers))+geom_point()+ggtitle("All")+geom_point(data=pep_pca[grep("P46108",Protein.Group)],color="black",cex=3)+ggtitle("All")#+geom_text_repel(size=2.5)

  


```



## Adding IsoFrac Info v1 

```{r}
library(gplots)
#temp <- fread("fulldataset.csv")
print("Loading UniSequences_all")
hu <- load("./ProteinSequences_UPproteolytic_PacBio_complete.rda")

print("Loading UniAcc")# protein sequence data information
hu1 <- load("./Additional_Data/ACC_Sequences.rda")
UniAcc <- data.table(UniAcc)
str(UniAcc)

print("Loading compiled IsoFrac Data including peptide sequences")

IsoFrac_with_Sequences <- fread("./Elli_20251006/ENSG_Peptide_Isofrac_Assembly_20260408.txt")


IsoFrac_with_Sequences$ENSG <- IsoFrac_with_Sequences$EnsG


IsoFrac_with_Sequences[ENSG=="ENSG00000076641"]
IsoFrac_with_Sequences[,IsoFracID:=paste(ENSG,round(MW_lm_Compressed_,-2))]
IsoFrac_with_Sequences[hgnc_symbol=="NFKB1",paste(MW_lm_Compressed_,collapse=";"),.(Seq)]
IsoFrac_with_Sequences[hgnc_symbol=="NFKB1"&Seq=="LEPVVSDAIYDSK"]
IsoFrac_with_Sequences_Best <- IsoFrac_with_Sequences[,.SD[score_ref==max(score_ref_gbm,na.rm=T)],.(IsoFracID,MW_lm_Compressed_,Seq)]

venn(split(IsoFrac_with_Sequences[hgnc_symbol=="TMPO"]$Seq,IsoFrac_with_Sequences[hgnc_symbol=="TMPO"]$IsoFrac_MW))

print("Loading Delta Mass Categories from Delta Mass plot of PacBio vs UniProt Figure")
DM <- load("/Users/henno/Documents/Skripte/R_Scripts/DataAnalysis/20210129_AK_ProteinIsoforms/20250821_Rebuttal/Elli_20251006/DeltaMassPlot_TemporaryExtraction_20260327.rda")

tempinfo <- DeltaMassFig$data
tempinfo[DM_min_categories=="Equal MassShift"&DM_PB_min<0]$DM_min_categories <- "Equal MassShift-"
tempinfo[DM_min_categories=="Equal MassShift"&DM_PB_min>0]$DM_min_categories <- "Equal MassShift+"
table(tempinfo$DM_min_categories)

IsoFrac_with_Sequences_Best[,c("Uniprot_Isoform_Category","Uniprot_IsoformType","DeltaMass_Category"):={
  
  tempi <- .SD
  gr <- .BY
  tempinfoi <- tempinfo[ENSG==gr$EnsG&tempinfo$IsoFrac_MW==gr$IsoFrac_MW,,]
  
  li <- list(Uniprot_Isoform_Category=tempinfoi$Uniprot_Isoform_Category,
       Uniprot_IsoformType=tempinfoi$UniprotIsoformType,
       DeltaMass_Category=tempinfoi$DM_min_categories)
  li <- lapply(li,paste,collapse=";")
  li
},.(EnsG,IsoFrac_MW)]

IsoFrac_with_Sequences_Best$ENSG <- IsoFrac_with_Sequences_Best$ENS
IsoFrac_with_Sequences_Best_Elli <- IsoFrac_with_Sequences_Best[,1,.(ENSG,hgnc_symbol,Seq,IsoFrac_MW,BestCluster,ClusterType,score_ref,Uniprot_MW,Uniprot_Isoform_Category,DeltaMass_Category)]
IsoFrac_with_Sequences_Best_Elli$V1 <- NULL
table(IsoFrac_with_Sequences_Best_Elli[hgnc_symbol=="TMPO"]$Seq)

IsoFrac_with_Sequences_Best_Elli$DeltaMass_Category_Fac <- factor(IsoFrac_with_Sequences_Best_Elli$DeltaMass_Category,c("Equal MassShift+" ,"Equal MassShift-","Correct Mass","Other","PACBIO correct-","UniProt correct-","PACBIO correct+","UniProt correct+"),
                                                                  c("PTMs","Putative_Processing","unknown","other","AS_or_processing","Processing","AS or PTMs","unknown")
                                                                  )

fwrite(IsoFrac_with_Sequences_Best_Elli,"IsoFrac_with_Sequences_Best_Elli.txt",sep="\t")

IsoFrac_LOPIT <- cbind(IsoFrac_with_Sequences_Best_Elli,FD[match(IsoFrac_with_Sequences_Best_Elli$Seq,FD$Stripped.Sequence),],pc[match(IsoFrac_with_Sequences_Best_Elli$Seq,FD$Stripped.Sequence),])
IsoFrac_LOPIT[hgnc_symbol=="CTSB"]
IsoFrac_LOPIT[hgnc_symbol=="CSTB"]

save(IsoFrac_LOPIT,file="IsoFrac_LOPIT_20260408.rda")

```
